one_line_definition: The engine body is not the graph; it is the structure that stores, defers, and rereads generated values and connection layers. Graph is one projection surface over that body.

ledger_body.role: records what happened, where the state is, and why it is there

layer_board_body.role: tracks which layer each material or candidate currently occupies

local_workbench.role: local judgment field around best_local_ref and nearby evidence

locked_sentences.engine_definition: We are not building space itself; we are building an engine that generates, stores, and rereads connection layers over inputs.
locked_sentences.body_definition: The body of the engine is ledger plus layer.
locked_sentences.field_definition: Actual judgment and review happen in the local workbench.
locked_sentences.view_definition: Graph and space are views, not the body.

final_lock: Graph is the map, workbench is the field, and the real vessel of the engine is ledger plus layer.
